name: Blue Thunder

specialAbility.name: Thunder Strike
specialAbility.description: Blue Thunder calls down a bolt of lightning from the sky that zaps the enemy and leaves them stunned!

lore: Blue Thunder was struck by lightning seventeen times and LIKED IT! Now this electrified truck carries a storm wherever it goes. Dark clouds roll in when its engine starts, and bolts of blue lightning crackle across its body. Touch it and you'll get the shock of your life!
